args.title: Fix parseAmount to strip rupee and other currency symbols
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

In parseAmount, the symbol-stripping regex `/[\s€$£¥]/g` omits the rupee sign (₹) and other currency symbols/prefixes, causing amounts like ₹1,250.00 to fail parsing and return null. Broaden the symbol stripping to cover ₹ and other known currency signs (and optionally letter-based prefixes like CHF plus the apostrophe thousands separator) so these amounts parse correctly.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The symbol-stripping regex in parseAmount does not include the rupee sign (₹) or other currency symbols, so inputs like ₹1,250.00 fail the numeric check and return null, triggering the badAmount error. Broadening the stripped symbol set should fix this.
